title: 10 Essential Tips for Planning the Perfect Wedding
excerpt: Discover the most important elements that make a wedding truly unforgettable. From venue selection to vendor coordination.
author: Sarah Ahmed

content.intro: Planning a wedding can be overwhelming, but with the right approach and attention to detail, you can create an unforgettable celebration that reflects your unique love story.

sections.heading: 1. Start with Your Budget
sections.content: Before making any decisions, establish a clear budget. This will guide all your choices and help you prioritize what matters most. Typically, allocate 40-50% for venue and catering, 10% for photography, 10% for attire, and 8% for flowers.

sections.heading: 2. Choose the Perfect Venue
sections.content: Your venue sets the tone for the entire celebration. Consider factors like guest count, season, style preference, and location accessibility. Book 12-18 months in advance for popular venues.

sections.heading: 3. Create a Detailed Timeline
sections.content: A well-planned timeline ensures smooth execution. Start planning 12-18 months ahead for major decisions, 6 months for vendors, and 2 months for final details.

sections.heading: 4. Select the Right Vendors
sections.content: Choose vendors who understand your vision and budget. Read reviews, check portfolios, and ensure they're available on your date. Key vendors include caterer, photographer, decorator, and entertainment.

sections.heading: 5. Plan Your Guest Experience
sections.content: Consider your guests' comfort from invitation to farewell. Provide clear directions, comfortable seating, good food, and entertainment that appeals to all age groups.

content.conclusion: Remember, your wedding should reflect your personality and love story. Don't stress about perfection – focus on creating meaningful moments with your loved ones.

author_bio.name: Sarah Ahmed
author_bio.bio: Sarah has planned over 200 weddings across Bangladesh and is known for her attention to detail and creative problem-solving skills.
